summary: No further change is proposed; the standing update.json is the accepted live-removal record. The audit's two asserted findings both rest on retained executions: the batched ReadIndex context substitution, supported by eight receipts spanning follower, control, timeout, observer, tick-driven, shared-confirmation and multi-requester cases, and the RequestAddNode ignored-target mismatch with its membership control. Four suspicions are refuted, two of them now measured: an unknown sender at both admission layers and a removed voter after a real RemoveNode. The configuration-change and vote-durability refutations and the snapshot-restore refutation remain source-only, and executing them would need apply-lag, crash-injection or snapshot-install harnesses whose construction cost outweighs what the decisive source arguments already establish. Every question is explained with exact knowledge uses and no necessary gaps remain.
